Log-likelihood of a litfit object

Source: R/output-fxns.R
logLik.litfit.Rd

Returns the log-likelihood of the fitted model, which allows the standard AIC and BIC functions to be used to compare several litfit objects, e.g. AIC(fit1, fit2).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'litfit'
logLik(object, ...)

Arguments

object

a litfit object

...

unused

Value

an object of class logLik

Details

The degrees of freedom are the number of fitted curve parameters (the residual standard deviation is not counted), consistent with the fitAIC, fitAICc and fitBIC values stored in the object and with Cornwell & Weedon (2013).
